measurementNote: Token/cost telemetry not exposed. Start is first observed UTC clock, after initial standards/manifest read; elapsed excludes that initial read. FDA full page verified; USDA search extracts verified, direct page open returned internal error.
scope: 12 frozen recipes; no recipe edits or review-status changes
severityPolicy: critical: categorical instruction can directly terminate cooking before safe doneness; major: material missing ingredient, safety ambiguity, ratio ambiguity or substantial timing failure; moderate: localized accuracy/usability defect. Open culinary questions are not established failures.
commonObservations: All12 lack complete recipe-specific learning schema and source-supported storage guidance; record as shared standard gap rather than12 duplicate material findings.

Serving scaler leaves method prose unchanged per standard; flag hard-coded portions/splits and vessel geometry. No universal proportional cook-time rule.
